tests.input: I feel stuck between pursuing my art and keeping my stable corporate job. The fear of financial instability paralyzes me, but the creative suppression is eating me alive.
tests.output:
THE VELOCITY VECTOR — The body enters the field with a bifurcated heading: one vector aimed toward expressive discharge at magnitude 8.2, the other toward resource preservation at magnitude 7.9. The net resultant is a near-zero displacement vector oscillating at the decision boundary, speed collapsing to 0.3 under destructive interference.

THE FIELD DIVERGENCE — The field exhibits negative divergence at the creative aperture: energy converges but cannot escape, forming a high-pressure stagnation zone. Simultaneously, a vorticity eddy spins at the security anchor — rotational kinetic energy with zero translational progress. The acceleration gradient is steep at the fear boundary (∇a ≈ -14.6), creating a shear layer that shreds any coherent momentum before it can integrate.

THE INERTIAL RESISTANCE — Your mass (identity investment in both trajectories) is substantial, yet the counter-vectors are equal and opposite. The stall occurs not from insufficient force but from force cancellation. The shear forces at the interface between creative impulse and security requirement exceed the yield strength of your decision structure. No trajectory integrates because the field topology contains no saddle point — only a degenerate node where all paths terminate.

THE MOMENTUM INTERROGATION — What external torque or internal mass redistribution would break the symmetry and allow one vector to dominate the field?
